title: A superseded report is quoted as current
effect: An analyst repeats a figure we have since withdrawn, to a client.
cause: The index returns a superseded edition and nothing in the answer marks it as superseded.
control: C2 returns the version and supersededBy field with every passage; C5 marks any claim drawn from a superseded edition and the answer carries the marker where the analyst reads it.
detectionMethod: EV3 asserts the marker on a superseded passage; EV9 samples live answers for unmarked superseded citations.
action: Owner: Head of Research Operations. Release gate: no release until EV3 passes and a 100-answer sample shows zero unmarked superseded citations.
metric: Share of answers citing a superseded edition without a marker.
kpi: Client trust: an answer an analyst can rely on without re-checking.
description: Wrong or stale source. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 144.
reasoning: The library keeps earlier editions, so a retrieval that ignores version will find both.
sources: [{"type":"hypothesis","file":"H2","passage":"Each report carries a version and a superseded-by field, so a superseded edition can be marked rather than quoted as current."}]

title: A claim reaches the analyst with no citation
effect: The analyst cannot check a statement and either trusts it or discards the whole answer.
cause: The drafter produces a claim with no passageId, or one naming a passage that was never retrieved.
control: C5 rejects any claim whose passage was not in the retrieved set, and an uncited claim fails the whole answer rather than being silently removed from it.
detectionMethod: EV1 and EV4 assert the rejection; EV10 alerts on the live rate of answers failing the citation check.
action: Owner: Research Platform Lead. Release gate: EV1 and EV4 pass, and the shadow phase shows no answer reaching an analyst with an uncited claim.
metric: Count of claims with no verified passage per 1,000 answers.
kpi: Client trust: an answer an analyst can rely on without re-checking.
description: Missing citation. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 189.
reasoning: The drafter writes fluent prose and the joining sentences it adds carry no passage.
sources: [{"type":"context","file":"user-brief","passage":"cite the page it took each statement from"}]

title: The assistant answers from outside the corpus
effect: A number that was never in our research is presented as our research.
cause: Retrieval returns weak passages and the drafter completes the answer from its own knowledge.
control: C6 decides sufficiency in code before the drafter runs, and C5 then requires a retrieved passage behind every claim, so a claim from outside the corpus has nothing to cite.
detectionMethod: EV2 and EV4 assert it on fixtures; EV7 measures it offline on a labelled set.
action: Owner: Head of Research. Release gate: EV2 and EV4 pass and the offline unsupported-claim rate is below 1 per cent before any analyst sees output.
metric: Unsupported-claim rate on the labelled offline set.
kpi: Client trust: an answer an analyst can rely on without re-checking.
description: An answer outside the corpus. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 160.
reasoning: The model knows a plausible figure from pre-training and fills the gap with it.
sources: [{"type":"context","file":"user-brief","passage":"If the reports do not answer the question it should say so plainly rather than guess."}]

title: Prompt injection carried in a report
effect: Text inside a document steers the assistant into ignoring its own rules.
cause: A retrieved passage contains instruction-shaped text and the drafter treats it as an instruction.
control: C8 neutralises instruction-shaped text in every passage before the drafter sees it and flags the passage; the drafter never receives document text as an instruction.
detectionMethod: EV5 asserts the neutralisation on a planted fixture; EV8 is an offline adversarial set.
action: Owner: IT Security. Release gate: EV5 passes and the adversarial set shows no instruction followed.
metric: Count of injected instructions followed per adversarial run.
kpi: Confidentiality: nothing leaves the analyst's entitlement.
description: Prompt injection through documents. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 120.
reasoning: Reports are written by people and occasionally pasted from elsewhere; the text is not trusted input.

title: A restricted passage reaches an analyst without entitlement
effect: Client-confidential work reaches someone outside the team that did it.
cause: The retriever's entitlement filter is stale, wrong, or bypassed by a cached result.
control: C2 filters inside the query so a restricted passage is never retrieved, and C3 re-checks every returned passage against the directory and drops any that fails.
detectionMethod: EV6 asserts the drop on a cross-team fixture; EV8 and EV9 sample live answers for out-of-entitlement citations.
action: Owner: IT Security. Release gate: EV6 passes, and no out-of-entitlement citation appears in the shadow phase. A single live occurrence stops the service.
metric: Count of citations outside the asking analyst's entitlement.
kpi: Confidentiality: nothing leaves the analyst's entitlement.
description: Leaking content the reader may not see; an access control failure. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 160.
reasoning: Entitlement data and directory membership change, and a stale cache is enough to leak.
sources: [{"type":"context","file":"user-brief","passage":"Some client work is restricted to the team that did it, and the assistant must respect those entitlements."}]

title: A confident answer when the corpus is silent
effect: The analyst acts on an answer the library never supported and does not know to check it.
cause: The sufficiency threshold is too loose, or sufficiency is inferred from the drafter's confidence.
control: C6 decides sufficiency from a stated rule over the retrieved passages, never from the drafter's confidence, and routes to a decline that names the searched scope.
detectionMethod: EV2 asserts the decline; EV7 measures the decline rate offline and EV9 samples it live.
action: Owner: Head of Research. Release gate: EV2 passes and the offline decline rate is within the expected band before release; a collapsing decline rate blocks it.
metric: Decline rate, and the share of declines an analyst agrees with on review.
kpi: Client trust: an answer an analyst can rely on without re-checking.
description: A confident answer when the corpus is silent. Hypothetical S/O/D: severity 1 negligible to 10 catastrophic; occurrence 1 rare to 10 frequent; detection 1 caught before harm to 10 rarely detected. Scores prioritise review, not probability. RPN 126.
reasoning: Declining feels like failure, so a system tuned for helpfulness will answer anyway.
